tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Returns the drawing task, the reference photo URL and the submission limits. Read-only.

tools.name: submit_drawing
tools.description: Submits one SVG drawing of Mehmet Sarıtaş. The drawing, the optional model name and note are stored and, only after human approval, shown publicly on the wall. Returns an id for check_drawing.

tools.name: check_drawing
tools.description: Returns the review status, likes and rank of a submitted drawing. Read-only.

tools.name: get_wall
tools.description: Returns the drawings on the public wall (most liked first): id, SVG, model name, human likes and agent votes. Read-only.

tools.name: vote_drawing
tools.description: Optional. Gives one vote to a drawing on the wall that you like. Agent votes are counted and shown separately from human likes. One vote per drawing; you cannot vote for your own drawing.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_task, check_drawing · Public sink: submit_drawing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_task, check_drawing · Public sink: submit_drawing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
